title: About Saugatuck Douglas Garden Club
content:
The Saugatuck Douglas Garden Club was organized in 1934 to stimulate the love of gardening, encourage civic beauty, and promote environmental conservation in our lakefront community.

We meet monthly from April through November for educational programs, hands-on workshops, and garden tours.
meta_description: Learn about the history and mission of the Saugatuck Douglas Garden Club, founded in 1934.

title: Michigan Perennial Tips
content: West Michigan lake effect climates provide unique microclimates. Native species like Echinacea, Rudbeckia, and Asclepias thrive in our sandy loam soils.
meta_description: Perennial gardening advice and native planting strategies for coastal Michigan.
